findings.description: Critical: check_test_contract.ASSERT_LINE_RE only matches lines that begin with assert/expect(...)/self.assert*/pytest.raises/should(/assertThat(. Common expectation-body edits are invisible: multi-line Jest/Vitest chains where only `.toBe(n)` / `.toEqual(n)` changes (with unified=0), `expect.soft(...)`, Rust `assert_eq!` / `assert_ne!`, and `mock.assert_called_with(...)`. Spec requires non-zero exit when expectation bodies change; these false negatives let a simplify range pass the mechanical contract while mutating pinned behavior.
findings.resolution: Expand matcher catalog (chained `.toBe|.toEqual|.toStrictEqual|.toThrow`, `expect\.\w+\s*\(`, `assert_eq!`/`assert_ne!`, `assert_called*`) and/or flag any +/- line inside a test path that looks like a matcher/assert body; add unit cases for multi-line expect and assert_eq!.

findings.description: Critical: TEST_PATH_RE does not treat Go `*_test.go` (or similar) as test paths. `foo_test.go` / `pkg/foo_test.go` return false, so the contract scanner never inspects Go test diffs even if assertion patterns were fixed. Go expectation edits always look clean.
findings.resolution: Extend TEST_PATH_RE with `_test\.go$` (and consider `_test\.rs$` outside tests/) and cover with is_test_path unit tests.

findings.description: Critical: Runtime skill mirrors are stale relative to canonical `skills/simplify/`. `.agents/skills/simplify/scripts/verify_behavior_preservation.py` still runs HEAD tests in the live working tree (`run_tests(test_cmd, repo, head_sha)`) and documents a non-existent stash fallback; `.agents`/`.claude` copies of check_test_contract lack pending_old_path deleted-file handling. Agents that resolve scripts from installed mirrors get the pre-fix dual-run and contract bugs despite tasks.md 5.2 claiming sync.
findings.resolution: Re-run `bash skills/install.sh --mode rsync --deps none --python-tools none` (or equivalent) and verify `.agents`/`.claude` match `skills/simplify` for SKILL.md and all three scripts before merge.

findings.description: Nit: Script tests cover happy paths (simple assert/expect line edits, deleted files, dual-run pass/fail) but not the known false negatives (multi-line `.toBe`, `expect.soft`, `assert_eq!`, Go `*_test.go` paths). Without those, the weak assertion/path detection will regress unnoticed.
findings.resolution: Add scan_unified_diff / is_test_path cases that currently fail and keep them red until matchers/paths are fixed.

findings.description: FYI: verify_behavior_preservation.run_tests executes --test-cmd with shell=True. Documented as trusted operator input (pytest/npm), which matches intended use, but any agent- or config-sourced string is full shell injection (metacharacters, command chaining).
findings.resolution: Keep trust boundary explicit in CLI help (already present). Optional hardening: default to shlex.split + shell=False, with an explicit --shell flag for compound commands.

findings.description: Optional: dual-run subprocess has no timeout. A hung test command blocks the helper indefinitely and can leave temporary worktrees until process kill; finally-block cleanup only runs after run_tests returns.
findings.resolution: Pass a configurable timeout to subprocess.run (e.g. --timeout-seconds) and treat timeout as failed run with report note.

findings.description: Optional: content invariants assert isomorphic/dead-code language but not "redundant intermediate", which the skill-workflow spec requires in the pattern catalog. A silent catalog regression of that pattern would not fail tests.

Nit: git may quote unusual paths in unified diffs (`--- "a/tests/my test.py"`). _strip_diff_path does not strip surrounding quotes or handle a/b/ inside quotes, so current_path can retain quote/prefix noise. Detection still often works via substring tests/ but is fragile for edge paths.
findings.resolution: Strip optional surrounding quotes and then a/ or b/ prefixes when normalizing ---/+++ paths; add a quoted-path unit case.

findings.description: none: Canonical simplify contract is strong: coverage gate + characterization-first workflow, dual-run verification via detached worktrees for both baseline and HEAD, assertion-contract/scope helpers with 0/1/2 exits, expanded isomorphic/dead-code/redundant-intermediate patterns, and Phase C routing (tech-debt → simplify/plan/deprecation/perf; implement/iterate optional polish; catalogue + skill-flow manual-only notes). Prior deleted-file and dirty-HEAD dual-run bugs are fixed in skills/simplify.
findings.resolution: Keep pattern; re-sync runtime mirrors so installed copies match.

findings.description: none: Ecosystem hooks match the spec scenarios: tech-debt remediation table routes local clarity/dup to /simplify and hubs/public-API/perf elsewhere; implement-feature and iterate-on-implementation document optional manual polish as separate refactor commits without making simplify required for completion.
